infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RecompOne uses the camera to scan food barcodes and optionally capture progress photos you choose to take.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RecompOne accesses only the progress or food photos you choose to add.

plugins.microphonePermission: RecompOne uses your microphone only when you choose to describe a meal by voice.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: RecompOne converts your spoken meal description into text for you to review. Apple may process speech online.
